label: C
install:
(
  set -eu
  command -v jq >/dev/null
  PLATFORM=${PLATFORM:-darwin-arm64}
  # Linux: PLATFORM=linux-x64-gnu or linux-arm64-gnu
  ASSET_URL=$(curl -fsSL 'https://api.github.com/repos/boxlite-ai/boxlite/releases?per_page=100' \
    | jq -er --arg platform "$PLATFORM" '
      first(.[] | select(.draft == false and .prerelease == false)
        | . as $release | .assets[]
        | select(.state == "uploaded")
        | select(.name == ("boxlite-c-" + $release.tag_name + "-" + $platform + ".tar.gz"))
        | .browser_download_url)')
  ARCHIVE=${ASSET_URL##*/}
  curl -fsSL "$ASSET_URL" -o "$ARCHIVE"
  tar xzf "$ARCHIVE"
  mv "${ARCHIVE%.tar.gz}" boxlite-c-sdk
  rm "$ARCHIVE"
)
setupDescription: Requires curl, jq and tar. Downloads the newest stable release with a C SDK archive for your platform. Set PLATFORM for Linux. The next step includes boxlite.h and links libboxlite.
executionDescription: Creates a Box, runs a command, starts a web server and prints a public preview URL. The script leaves the Box running; idle auto-stop still applies.
